_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chw-reset-pumping (docs/workbook/plant-chw-reset-pumping.md): the chilled-water distribution side of the lbnl-chiller plant. chw_plant_reset regresses chiller 1's leaving-water temperature on the outdoor dry-bulb over its running, occupied hours (the run gate is the chiller's power: its status point is an enable, see the data issues) and reports the loop delta-T against its 8 F design minimum (design_deltaT_min_f); since 0.98 (#86) it also checks the reset's sign (expected_reset_sign: negative) and reads chiller 1's flow (CHL_CW_FLOW_1, chw_flow), which is constant while it runs (coefficient of variation <= 0.11% on every run), so the low delta-T is reported but not judged (flow_mode: auto). chw_pump_dp_reset reads the secondary loop's lead pump speed (CWL_SEC_PM_SPD_1) and its DP setpoint (CWL_SEC_DPSPT), both mapped since 0.97; its near-full band (90%) is fixed, and since 0.98 its near-minimum band is learned from the pump's VFD floor (near_min_pct: auto; 34.5% here). The exercise keeps every default, so there are no params.
